candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to 'number' so it writes a different value (increment _number by 1) causing stored number to differ after the call.
Replace assignment to 'number' with assignment of a constant zero, causing stored number to differ when _number was non-zero.
Relax onlyDepositor check to allow any caller (remove require), so calls by non-depositor can set number leading to different observable outcomes depending on caller.
